items.title: A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System
items.summary: Sources tell WIRED that an Accenture employee’s personal Claude agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.
items.why_relevant: AI agent进国防系统，安全风险

confirmed_facts.text: Earlier this year, sources tell WIRED, a contractor caused a security incident at the Department of Defense by connecting a secure centralized system used by multiple intelligence agencies to their personal account for Claude Code, Anthropic’s AI coding agent.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Earlier this year, sources tell WIRED, a contractor caused a security incident at the Department of Defense by connecting a secure centralized system used by multiple intelligence agencies to their personal account for Claude Code, Anthropic’s AI coding agent.

confirmed_facts.text: The centralized system contains controlled unclassified information (CUI), which is considered sensitive and not to be released to the public without review.

items.title: Binance 'potential security issue' sees $2.54 billion frozen by the likes of Circle, Tether

items.title: European Central Bank (ECB) head Christine Lagarde to step down in February, before her term ends
items.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde is to resign nine months ahead of the end of her 8-year term. European Council President Antonio Costa has said the process to find a successor is underway.
items.why_relevant: 欧央行行长辞职，宏观地缘重要

confirmed_facts.text: ECB head Christine Lagarde to step down in February October 29, 2026 Christine Lagarde, who has headed the European Central Bank for seven years, has announced that she is stepping down prematurely from the position.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: ECB head Christine Lagarde to step down in February October 29, 2026 Christine Lagarde, who has headed the European Central Bank for seven years, has announced that she is stepping down prematurely from the position.

confirmed_facts.text: "European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde today informed the Governing Council and the president of the European Council Antonio Costa that she will step down from her position on 7 February 2027," the ECB said in a statement.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: "European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde today informed the Governing Council and the president of the European Council Antonio Costa that she will step down from her position on 7 February 2027," the ECB said in a statement.

confirmed_facts.text: European Council President Antonio Costa said a process to find her successor would start immediately.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: European Council President Antonio Costa said a process to find her successor would start immediately.

confirmed_facts.text: No reason has so far been given for Lagarde's premature departure, but there has been speculation that she would leave early to enable EU leaders to choose her successor before French elections in the spring that could see a eurosceptic far-right victory influence the choice.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: No reason has so far been given for Lagarde's premature departure, but there has been speculation that she would leave early to enable EU leaders to choose her successor before French elections in the spring that could see a eurosceptic far-right victory influence the choice.

confirmed_facts.text: Her term, which began on November 1, 2019, would normally have ended at the end of October 2027.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Her term, which began on November 1, 2019, would normally have ended at the end of October 2027.

confirmed_facts.text: Lagarde 'provided steady and determine stewardship' — Costa Costa praised Lagarde's leadership during her seven-year stint at the ECB helm, a period in which the EU and the world faced great challenges.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Lagarde 'provided steady and determine stewardship' — Costa Costa praised Lagarde's leadership during her seven-year stint at the ECB helm, a period in which the EU and the world faced great challenges.
